question: Which dynasty is recorded in the chronicles as the first ruling dynasty of the Kathmandu Valley?
explanation: The chronicles (Gopal Raj Vamsavali) record the Gopala dynasty of cowherds as the first rulers of the Kathmandu Valley.
source: First dynasty of Kathmandu Valley — Gopala
question_ne: काठमाडौं उपत्यकाको पहिलो शासक वंश कुन हो भनेर वंशावलीहरूमा लेखिएको छ?
explanation_ne: वंशावलीहरू (गोपाल राज वंशावली) ले गोपाल वंशका ग्वालाहरूलाई काठमाडौं उपत्यकाका पहिलो शासक मान्छन्।

question: According to the chronicles, who was the first king of the Gopala dynasty?
explanation: Bhuktaman is recorded as the first king of the Gopala dynasty, the earliest rulers of the Kathmandu Valley.
question_ne: वंशावलीअनुसार गोपाल वंशका पहिलो राजा को थिए?
explanation_ne: भुक्तमान गोपाल वंशका पहिलो राजा मानिन्छन्; उनीहरू काठमाडौं उपत्यकाका सबैभन्दा पुराना शासक हुन्।

question: Which dynasty followed the Gopala dynasty as rulers of the Kathmandu Valley?
explanation: The Mahispala dynasty of buffalo herders followed the Gopala dynasty in the chronicles of the Kathmandu Valley.
question_ne: काठमाडौं उपत्यकामा गोपाल वंशपछि कुन वंशले शासन गर्‍यो?
explanation_ne: काठमाडौं उपत्यकाका वंशावलीहरूमा गोपाल वंशपछि भैंसीपालकहरूको महिषपाल वंशले शासन गर्‍यो।

question: For about how many years did the Kirata dynasty rule the Kathmandu Valley?
explanation: The Kirata dynasty is traditionally said to have ruled the Kathmandu Valley for about 800 years before the Licchavis.
question_ne: किराँत वंशले काठमाडौं उपत्यकामा करिब कति वर्ष शासन गर्‍यो?
explanation_ne: किराँत वंशले लिच्छविहरूअघि काठमाडौं उपत्यकामा करिब ८०० वर्ष शासन गरेको परम्परागत मान्यता छ।

question: The Kirata period of Nepal is associated with which hero of the Mahabharata, said to have fought Arjuna?
explanation: Yalambar, the first Kirata king in tradition, is identified in legend with the Kirata hero who fought Arjuna in the Mahabharata.
question_ne: नेपालको किराँत काल महाभारतका कुन वीरसँग जोडिन्छ, जसले अर्जुनसँग लडेका थिए भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: परम्परामा पहिला किराँत राजा यलम्बरलाई महाभारतमा अर्जुनसँग लडेका किराँत वीरसँग जोडिन्छ।

question: Which of the following is a Kirata language still spoken in eastern Nepal?
explanation: Limbu is a Kirata language of eastern Nepal, spoken by the Limbu people and written in the Sirijanga script.
question_ne: पूर्वी नेपालमा अझै बोलिने किराँत भाषा कुन हो?
explanation_ne: लिम्बू पूर्वी नेपालको किराँत भाषा हो; यसलाई लिम्बू समुदायले बोल्छन् र सिरिजङ्गा लिपिमा लेखिन्छ।

question: The Mundhum is the sacred oral tradition of which people?
explanation: The Mundhum is the sacred oral scripture and ritual tradition of the Kirata peoples, especially the Rai and Limbu.
question_ne: मुन्धुम कुन समुदायको पवित्र मौखिक परम्परा हो?
explanation_ne: मुन्धुम किराँत समुदाय, विशेष गरी राई र लिम्बूहरूको पवित्र मौखिक धर्मग्रन्थ र अनुष्ठान परम्परा हो।

question: The Licchavi dynasty ruled the Kathmandu Valley roughly during which centuries?
explanation: The Licchavi dynasty ruled the Kathmandu Valley from about the 4th to the 8th century AD.
question_ne: लिच्छवि वंशले काठमाडौं उपत्यकामा करिब कुन शताब्दीहरूमा शासन गर्‍यो?
explanation_ne: लिच्छवि वंशले काठमाडौं उपत्यकामा करिब इस्वी संवत् चौथोदेखि आठौं शताब्दीसम्म शासन गर्‍यो।

question: The oldest dated stone inscription of Nepal is at Changu Narayan and was made in which year?
explanation: The Changu Narayan inscription of King Manadeva I, dated 464 AD, is the oldest dated stone inscription in Nepal.
question_ne: नेपालको सबैभन्दा पुरानो मिति भएको शिलालेख चाँगुनारायणमा छ; यो कुन वर्षको हो?
explanation_ne: राजा मानदेव प्रथमको चाँगुनारायण शिलालेख, मिति इस्वी संवत् ४६४, नेपालको सबैभन्दा पुरानो मिति भएको शिलालेख हो।

question: Which Licchavi king issued the Changu Narayan inscription of 464 AD?
explanation: King Manadeva I issued the Changu Narayan inscription in 464 AD, the oldest dated inscription in Nepal.
question_ne: इस्वी संवत् ४६४ को चाँगुनारायण शिलालेख कुन लिच्छवि राजाले जारी गरे?
explanation_ne: राजा मानदेव प्रथमले इस्वी संवत् ४६४ मा चाँगुनारायण शिलालेख जारी गरे; यो नेपालको सबैभन्दा पुरानो मिति भएको शिलालेख हो।

question: During whose reign did the Licchavi king Manadeva I rule?
explanation: Manadeva I, famous for the Changu Narayan inscription, reigned about 464–505 AD.
question_ne: लिच्छवि राजा मानदेव प्रथमले कुन अवधिमा शासन गरे?
explanation_ne: चाँगुनारायण शिलालेखका लागि प्रसिद्ध मानदेव प्रथमले करिब इस्वी संवत् ४६४–५०५ मा शासन गरे।

question: Which Licchavi ruler is known as the 'first historical king' of Nepal and built the Kailashkut Bhawan palace?
explanation: Amshuverma (reigned c. 605–621 AD) is a great Licchavi ruler who built the Kailashkut Bhawan palace and issued many inscriptions.
question_ne: कैलाशकूट भवन दरबार बनाउने र नेपालका 'पहिला ऐतिहासिक राजा' भनेर चिनिने लिच्छवि शासक को हुन्?
explanation_ne: अंशुवर्मा (शासन करिब इस्वी संवत् ६०५–६२१) महान् लिच्छवि शासक हुन्; उनले कैलाशकूट भवन दरबार बनाए र धेरै शिलालेख जारी गरे।

question: Amshuverma, the great Licchavi ruler, reigned during which years?
explanation: Amshuverma reigned about 605–621 AD, a golden age of Licchavi art, trade and administration.
question_ne: महान् लिच्छवि शासक अंशुवर्माले कुन वर्षहरूमा शासन गरे?
explanation_ne: अंशुवर्माले करिब इस्वी संवत् ६०५–६२१ मा शासन गरे; यो लिच्छवि कला, व्यापार र प्रशासनको स्वर्ण युग थियो।

question: Which Licchavi king invited the Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang's contemporary and restored relations with Tibet?
explanation: Narendradeva (reigned c. 643–679 AD) restored the Licchavi throne with Tibetan help and ruled a prosperous kingdom.
question_ne: तिब्बतसँगको सहयोगमा लिच्छवि गद्दी पुनर्स्थापना गर्ने लिच्छवि राजा को थिए?
explanation_ne: नरेन्द्रदेव (शासन करिब इस्वी संवत् ६४३–६७९) ले तिब्बती सहयोगमा लिच्छवि गद्दी पुनर्स्थापना गरे र समृद्ध राज्य चलाए।

question: The Changu Narayan Temple is regarded as the oldest temple of Nepal. In which century was it built?
explanation: Changu Narayan Temple, built in the 4th century AD during the Licchavi period, is the oldest Hindu temple in Nepal.
question_ne: चाँगुनारायण मन्दिरलाई नेपालको सबैभन्दा पुरानो मन्दिर मानिन्छ। यो कुन शताब्दीमा बनाइएको थियो?
explanation_ne: चाँगुनारायण मन्दिर लिच्छवि कालमा इस्वी संवत् चौथो शताब्दीमा बनाइएको थियो; यो नेपालको सबैभन्दा पुरानो हिन्दू मन्दिर हो।

question: During the Licchavi period, Nepal's trade with Tibet and India passed through which famous pass?
explanation: During the Licchavi period, trade with Tibet went through the Kuti Pass, the ancient trans-Himalayan trade route.
question_ne: लिच्छवि कालमा नेपालको तिब्बत र भारतसँगको व्यापार कुन प्रसिद्ध नाकाबाट हुन्थ्यो?
explanation_ne: लिच्छवि कालमा तिब्बतसँगको व्यापार कुटी नाकाबाट हुन्थ्यो; यो प्राचीन हिमालपार व्यापार मार्ग थियो।

question: Which script was used in the Licchavi inscriptions of Nepal?
explanation: Licchavi inscriptions were written in the Brahmi-derived Gupta script, the ancestor of later Nepali scripts.
question_ne: नेपालका लिच्छवि शिलालेखहरूमा कुन लिपि प्रयोग गरिएको थियो?
explanation_ne: लिच्छवि शिलालेखहरू ब्राह्मीबाट व्युत्पन्न गुप्त लिपिमा लेखिएका थिए; यो पछिल्ला नेपाली लिपिहरूको पूर्वज हो।

question: The Malla period of the Kathmandu Valley lasted roughly from which year to 1769?
explanation: The Malla period began with Arideva Malla in 1201 AD and ended with the Gorkha conquest in 1769.
question_ne: काठमाडौं उपत्यकाको मल्ल काल करिब कुन वर्षदेखि १७६९ सम्म चल्यो?
explanation_ne: मल्ल काल अरिदेव मल्लसँग इस्वी संवत् १२०१ मा सुरु भयो र १७६९ मा गोर्खा विजयसँग अन्त्य भयो।

question: After Yaksha Malla's division, which of his sons became the king of Kathmandu (Kantipur)?
explanation: Ratna Malla, son of Yaksha Malla, became the first Malla king of Kathmandu (Kantipur) after the 1482 division.
source: Ratna Malla — first king of Kantipur
question_ne: यक्ष मल्लको विभाजनपछि उनका कुन छोरा काठमाडौं (कान्तिपुर) का राजा भए?
explanation_ne: यक्ष मल्लका छोरा रत्न मल्ल १४८२ को विभाजनपछि काठमाडौं (कान्तिपुर) का पहिला मल्ल राजा भए।

question: Jayasthiti Malla, the great law-giver of the Malla period, reigned during which years?
explanation: Jayasthiti Malla reigned from 1382 to 1395 and is remembered for codifying laws and social customs.
question_ne: मल्ल कालका महान् कानुन निर्माता जयस्थिति मल्लले कुन वर्षहरूमा शासन गरे?
explanation_ne: जयस्थिति मल्लले १३८२ देखि १३९५ सम्म शासन गरे; उनलाई कानुन र सामाजिक प्रथा संहिताबद्ध गरेकोमा सम्झिन्छन्।

question: Which Malla king of Kathmandu is remembered for building the Rani Pokhari and for his love of arts?
explanation: Pratap Malla (reigned 1641–1674) of Kathmandu was a great patron of art and literature and built Rani Pokhari in 1670.
question_ne: रानीपोखरी बनाउने र कलाप्रेमीका रूपमा सम्झिने काठमाडौंका मल्ल राजा को हुन्?
explanation_ne: काठमाडौंका प्रताप मल्ल (शासन १६४१–१६७४) कला र साहित्यका महान् संरक्षक थिए; उनले १६७० मा रानीपोखरी बनाए।

question: Pratap Malla, the Malla king of Kathmandu, reigned during which years?
explanation: Pratap Malla reigned in Kathmandu from 1641 to 1674, a golden age of Malla art and literature.
question_ne: काठमाडौंका मल्ल राजा प्रताप मल्लले कुन वर्षहरूमा शासन गरे?
explanation_ne: प्रताप मल्लले काठमाडौंमा १६४१ देखि १६७४ सम्म शासन गरे; यो मल्ल कला र साहित्यको स्वर्ण युग थियो।

question: In which year was the Krishna Mandir of Patan built?
explanation: The Krishna Mandir of Patan Durbar Square was built in 1637 by Siddhi Narasimha Malla.
question_ne: पाटनको कृष्ण मन्दिर कुन वर्षमा बनाइएको थियो?
explanation_ne: पाटन दरबार क्षेत्रको कृष्ण मन्दिर इस्वी संवत् १६३७ मा सिद्धिनरसिंह मल्लले बनाए।

question: Bhupatindra Malla, the great builder king of Bhaktapur, reigned during which years?
explanation: Bhupatindra Malla reigned in Bhaktapur from 1696 to 1722 and built the Nyatapola Temple and the 55-Window Palace.
question_ne: भक्तपुरका महान् निर्माता राजा भूपतीन्द्र मल्लले कुन वर्षहरूमा शासन गरे?
explanation_ne: भूपतीन्द्र मल्लले भक्तपुरमा १६९६ देखि १७२२ सम्म शासन गरे; उनले न्यातपोल मन्दिर र ५५ झ्याले दरबार बनाए।

question: In which year was the Nyatapola Temple of Bhaktapur built?
explanation: The five-storey Nyatapola Temple of Bhaktapur was built in 1702 by King Bhupatindra Malla.
question_ne: भक्तपुरको न्यातपोल मन्दिर कुन वर्षमा बनाइएको थियो?
explanation_ne: भक्तपुरको पाँचतले न्यातपोल मन्दिर इस्वी संवत् १७०२ मा राजा भूपतीन्द्र मल्लले बनाए।

question: How many storeys (roofs) does the Nyatapola Temple of Bhaktapur have?
explanation: The Nyatapola Temple is a five-storey (five-roofed) pagoda temple, the tallest temple in Nepal.
question_ne: भक्तपुरको न्यातपोल मन्दिरमा कति तला (छाना) छन्?
explanation_ne: न्यातपोल मन्दिर पाँचतले (पाँच छानासहितको) प्यागोडा मन्दिर हो; यो नेपालको सबैभन्दा अग्लो मन्दिर हो।

question: Who was the last Malla king of Bhaktapur?
explanation: Ranajit Malla (reigned 1722–1769) was the last Malla king of Bhaktapur, defeated by Prithvi Narayan Shah.
source: Last Malla king of Bhaktapur — Ranajit Malla
question_ne: भक्तपुरका अन्तिम मल्ल राजा को थिए?
explanation_ne: रणजीत मल्ल (शासन १७२२–१७६९) भक्तपुरका अन्तिम मल्ल राजा थिए; उनी पृथ्वीनारायण शाहबाट पराजित भए।

question: Who was the last Malla king of Kathmandu (Kantipur)?
explanation: Jaya Prakash Malla (reigned 1736–1768) was the last Malla king of Kathmandu, defeated by Prithvi Narayan Shah in 1768.
source: Last Malla king of Kathmandu — Jaya Prakash Malla
question_ne: काठमाडौं (कान्तिपुर) का अन्तिम मल्ल राजा को थिए?
explanation_ne: जयप्रकाश मल्ल (शासन १७३६–१७६८) काठमाडौंका अन्तिम मल्ल राजा थिए; उनी १७६८ मा पृथ्वीनारायण शाहबाट पराजित भए।

question: Which Newar artist of the Malla period built the White Pagoda (Baita) in Beijing, China?
explanation: Araniko (1245–1306), a Newar artist from the Kathmandu Valley, built the White Pagoda in Beijing for Kublai Khan.
source: Araniko built White Pagoda in Beijing
question_ne: मल्ल कालका कुन नेवार कलाकारले चीनको बेइजिङमा सेतो स्तूप (बैता) बनाए?
explanation_ne: अरनिको (१२४५–१३०६), काठमाडौं उपत्यकाका नेवार कलाकार, कुब्लाई खानका लागि बेइजिङमा सेतो स्तूप बनाए।

question: In which year did Araniko, the Newar artist, go to China?
explanation: Araniko went to China in 1260 at the age of 15, leading a team of 80 artists to build Buddhist monuments.
question_ne: नेवार कलाकार अरनिको कुन वर्षमा चीन गए?
explanation_ne: अरनिको १५ वर्षको उमेरमा इस्वी संवत् १२६० मा चीन गए; उनले ८० कलाकारको टोलीको नेतृत्व गर्दै बौद्ध स्मारकहरू बनाए।

question: Araniko built the White Pagoda in Beijing for which Mongol emperor?
explanation: Araniko built the White Pagoda (Baita) in Beijing for Kublai Khan, the founder of the Yuan dynasty.
question_ne: अरनिकोले बेइजिङको सेतो स्तूप कुन मंगोल सम्राटका लागि बनाए?
explanation_ne: अरनिकोले युआन वंशका संस्थापक कुब्लाई खानका लागि बेइजिङमा सेतो स्तूप (बैता) बनाए।

question: The Taleju Temple of Kathmandu Durbar Square was built in which year?
explanation: The Taleju Temple in Kathmandu Durbar Square was built in 1564 by King Mahendra Malla.
question_ne: काठमाडौं दरबार क्षेत्रको तलेजु मन्दिर कुन वर्षमा बनाइएको थियो?
explanation_ne: काठमाडौं दरबार क्षेत्रको तलेजु मन्दिर इस्वी संवत् १५६४ मा राजा महेन्द्र मल्लले बनाए।

question: The Kasthamandap, from which Kathmandu takes its name, was built in about which century?
explanation: Kasthamandap, the wooden pavilion that gave Kathmandu its name, was built in about the 12th century from a single sal tree.
question_ne: काठमाडौंको नाम आएको काष्ठमण्डप करिब कुन शताब्दीमा बनाइएको थियो?
explanation_ne: काठमाडौंलाई नाम दिने काठको मण्डप काष्ठमण्डप करिब बाह्रौं शताब्दीमा एउटै साल रूखबाट बनाइएको थियो।

question: The city of Kathmandu is named after which structure?
